svg.title: Boundary-Supervised Relation Interval Decoder
svg.desc: Proposed architecture retaining VrdONE BSA, multiscale temporal features, query decoder and predicate classification. An optional adjacent-frame difference branch precedes BSA. New query-conditioned start and end distributions, supervised by event boundaries, replace threshold-hull temporal decoding. A train-only fitted soft duration prior supports ordered joint interval selection. The coarse mask is auxiliary only. No measured predictions or gains are depicted. All computation, vector data, connectors and text are editable SVG geometry; two original input photographs are embedded.
svg.text: pstart = Softmax over valid start positions
pend = Softmax over valid end positions
Supervision: matched GT start and end coordinates
Soft score; no hard duration cutoff
Long and short instances remain admissible
Sk(i,j) = log pstart(i) + log pend(j) + λ log pL(j−i | p̂k)
(i*, j*) = argmax Sk(i,j), subject to i < j
Design proposal · one interval per query · effectiveness unverified
